settings.name: USE_OPENAPI_VALIDATOR
settings.description: Enable OpenAPI route validation for this site.

settings.name: OPENAPI_SPEC
settings.description: Absolute path or HTTP(S) URL to the OpenAPI (swagger) document in JSON/YAML format.

settings.name: OPENAPI_BASE_PATH
settings.description: Optional base path prefix to prepend to every path in the spec (overrides servers[*].url path).

settings.name: OPENAPI_ALLOW_UNSPECIFIED
settings.description: Allow requests to paths not listed in the specification (otherwise they are denied).

settings.name: OPENAPI_ALLOW_INSECURE_URL
settings.description: Allow fetching the OpenAPI spec over plain HTTP (not recommended).

settings.name: OPENAPI_IGNORE_URLS
settings.description: List of URL regexes to bypass OpenAPI validation (space separated).

settings.name: OPENAPI_MAX_SPEC_SIZE
settings.description: Maximum allowed size of the OpenAPI document (accepts suffix k/M/G).

settings.name: OPENAPI_VALIDATE_PARAMS
settings.description: Validate query, header, cookie, and path parameters against the OpenAPI specification.
